Normally, contracts between Trainers and Umamusume
are made after seeing them run in Debut Races. But—

Well, obvs! 'Cause I'm a total genius, y'know?♪
Nfufu~, ehehe~!
Pandora-san! Fusaichi Pandora-san!

Properly? I totally did!
I tried, like, the hardest I've tried all year! For real, for real!!

The problem... on the board...?
Umm, uhhh... The answer is...
Wanna scout her?

Eeeek!!
Aww maaann, I got in troubllle~!

Mmm, it's fine, it's fine♪ I can win just like that.
I always pull it off somehow, whether it's races or classes☆

"Such raw talent," huh?
...Hah, I wouldn't be so sure.
Regardless! You must not sleep during class!

Don't "yeeesssh" me. Were you listening?
If you were, solve the problem on the blackboard.
She seemed without a doubt to be an exceptional talent, but—

Waha☆ Am I amazing or what?!
When was the last time I even tried this hard?!
H-Hey... could you try running just once more, but properly?
Mmmwah♡

An Umamusume is about more than just talent.
No matter how good her legs or physique might be...

...She was like a marshmallow. No matter how much I pleaded
or tried to spur her on, nothing seemed to get through to her.

If her spirit isn't in it, it's pointless. I wouldn't bother reaching out.
Above all—I can't stand that lack of grit.

T-Then... could you promise to take racing
more seriously in the future? If you promise that...

Yeah~, easy-peasy, love and peeeace☆
Stuff like this is a total breeze, even in my sleep♪

Ahaha, this is so hype♪
Yep, yep! I really am a total legend, aren't I?♡

Plug it right into ①, and you get
(x, y) = (3, 2)! ...Or somethin'?
Ummm, well then...

Maybe I'll pick someone else♪
I don't really know about the future and stuff anyway.

Fusaichi Pandora, I want to see you run again.
Not just cruising like before, but giving it your all this time, okay?

Did a crepe stand just pass by or something?
Fusaichi Pandora began wandering aimlessly over—

And now, it's time for today's Winning Live!!
Taking center stage after a magnificent victory is—

She was barely even cruising. Yet, her effortless, polished stride
was distinctly different from any other Umamusume.
*sniff* *sniff*... *sniff* *sniff* *sniff*...

Hey, you're a Trainer too, right?
In that case, do you wanna...

She didn't race forward like a bolt of lightning.
She was putting in a bit more effort than before, but still...

(But hey, no matter what class it is, I don't even have to listen
and it's no sweat☆ After all, I'm...!)

Hmm... for real, huh...
Okey-doke☆ In my own way, then♪

—!! ...That is correct.
It seems your mind is working properly, at least.

Ehehehe~, which win was this again~?
Seven, eight, nine... so maaany☆

For top-tier prospects, contracts are sometimes decided beforehand.
Being approached is proof of high potential, however...

Ooooh, as expected of me, everyone wants a piece of this♡
What should I do~☆
Here goeees! Tah☆
See? Told ya so.
I smell something sooo sweet from somewhere...♪

A bit more than that... or should I say, give it your real best...
Please, pretty please?

You'll see soon enough.
Just watch.
Hyah?! Y-Yeeesssh???
Ehehehehe~... *drool* *slurp*...
What's wrong?
This one!
Ah, ehehehe~ Found you♪

It was on the day of the mock races—
that I happened to see that Umamusume.

—Fusaichi Pandora!
Just how many GⅠ victories does that make now?!

And so, Fusaichi Pandora twirled her hair,
took her place at the starting line, and with the force of lightning—

Man, that was quite a run☆
Ah, I want juice! Gimme juice♪

Hey, Fusaichi Pandora! Why not sign a contract with me?
With talent like this, there's no need to wait for the Debut Race.
La-la-laaa~, taaaah...☆

Alrighty.
Let's get this show on the road, then♪

(I'm a genius who's gonna be a
suuuper big deal in the Twinkle Series one day, after all♪)
